entries.question_fil: Paano magtipid ng tubig at kuryente sa BHS nang ligtas?
entries.question_en: How can the BHS conserve water and electricity safely?
entries.answer_fil: Targetin ang tagas at hindi kailangang konsumo. Panatilihin ang hand hygiene, bentilasyon at kritikal na kagamitan; sundin ang facility instructions.
entries.answer_en: Target leaks and unnecessary use. Preserve hand hygiene, ventilation and critical equipment; follow facility instructions.

entries.question_fil: Ano ang ligtas na reusable material sa health teaching?
entries.question_en: What is a safe reusable material for health teaching?
entries.answer_fil: Maaaring gumamit ng matibay na teaching visual ayon sa facility policy. Hindi kasama rito ang pagre-reuse ng karayom, lancet o iba pang clinical single-use item.
entries.answer_en: A durable teaching visual can be reused under facility policy. This does not permit reusing needles, lancets or other clinical single-use items.

entries.question_fil: Paano maiiwasan ang duplicate orders ng supplies?
entries.question_en: How can duplicate supply orders be avoided?
entries.answer_fil: Gumamit ng may-label na storage at stock count bago umorder. Sundin ang expiry procedure at iulat ang expired o sirang stock; magtakda ng taong susuri sa routine.
entries.answer_en: Use labeled storage and count stock before ordering. Follow expiry procedures and report expired or damaged stock; assign someone to check the routine.

entries.question_fil: Paano susukatin kung epektibo ang resource-saving routine?
entries.question_en: How do we measure whether a resource-saving routine works?
entries.answer_fil: Ihambing ang konsumo o rework sa magkatulad na workload bago at matapos. Tingnan din kung naihatid nang ligtas at tama ang serbisyo. Mag-review kasama ang may-ari ng routine.
entries.answer_en: Compare consumption or rework for similar workloads before and after. Check that services remained safe and correct. Review with the routine’s owner.
